text:
june: kicking off 19:00 UTC change window for auth-service v3.0.0-canary. rollout plan: 10% -> 30% -> 100% over ~45m. key watchers: p95, 4xx auth-fails, tokenization latency. runcmd: `rctl deploy canary auth-service:3.0.0 --traffic 10`

liam: oncall this window. my thresholds: p95 > 700ms OR auth 4xx > 0.6% sustained for 4m -> hold/rollback. watching from 19:00-21:00 UTC.

deploy-bot: Canary started: auth-service:3.0.0 -> 10% traffic. smoke checks: PASS. hook: integration-mock ok. ETA next step ~12m.

obs-bot: ALERT (19:04 UTC): spike detected on /v1/tokenize 13% 5xx in last 60s (baseline 0.1%). source: tokenizer-pool-01. probe id: tok-guard-19.
maya: got it. tracing shows queueing on tokenizer-worker-02; worker restarts in logs. collecting `kubectl get pods -l app=tokenizer -o wide` now.

liam: recommend pinning tokenization route for canary traffic to stable tokenizer pool while we dig in. avoids full rollback.

june: agree. execute routing pin and pause rollout.

maya: running pin: `rctl route pin --route /v1/tokenize --target stable-tokenizer --scope canary` -> applied.

deploy-bot: Rollout PAUSED at 10% by june (manual). Reason: tokenizer 5xx spike. Time: 19:06 UTC.

obs-bot: metric update (19:08 UTC): after pin, /v1/tokenize 5xx down to 0.12% over 2m. overall auth p95 improved from 420ms -> 360ms.

liam: good signal. keep paused for 15m to validate. if stable for 10m, we can continue to 30% with tokenization pin still active. also suggest increasing tokenizer replicas +1 as a precaution.

maya: scaling tokenizer pool: `kubectl scale deployment tokenizer --replicas=4 -n prod` initiated. will tail until stable.

june: adding note to release notes: "temporary pin of /v1/tokenize to stable-tokenizer during canary due to worker restarts" and linking to incident ticket.

devops-bot: Autoscaler suggestion: predicted CPU/GPU spike on tokenizer over next 30m; recommended +1 replica (applied).

obs-bot: 19:16 UTC snapshot: no new 5xx on tokenization, p95 auth steady at 340ms, error budget usage nominal.

liam: decision window open. i'm comfortable moving to 30% while keeping the pin. resume when you give the go june.

june: resuming to 30% at 19:18 UTC. deploy command: `rctl deploy continue --to 30`

deploy-bot: Canary progressed to 30%. Monitoring enabled: p50/p95/p99, 5xx and auth-4xx alarms.

obs-bot: 19:25 UTC: transient bump in 4xx auth (0.9%) from a small client cohort: request ID prefix abc123. Investigating if this is related to a header change in v3.0.0.
maya: found malformed header handling in tokenizer client lib used by that cohort. rolling a targeted header-fallback rule for that client id list.

liam: if 4xx persists >1% for 5m, we should consider partial rollback of auth route back to v2 for that client group. Otherwise continue.

june: agreed. applying targeted rollback only for affected client cohort if it stays high.

obs-bot: 19:31 UTC: 4xx dropped to baseline after header-fallback. no other anomalies.

june: proceeding to 100% gradually over remaining 20m. leaving tokenization pin in place until we complete a follow-up unpin plan (post-deploy).

maya: creating follow-up task to harden tokenizer worker restart path and add readiness probe tweak. ticket: REL-9902.

liam: will author a short blameless post-deploy note summarizing decision to pin route and the partial cohort fallback.

june: closing watch. rollout completed at 19:45 UTC to 100% with pin still active for /v1/tokenize. next actions: unpin after tokenizers vetted + a capacity test. cc @product for release-note summary.
